readingColumn.description:
Holds the form to a single reading column, up to 720px (45rem), instead of the full width of
its container. Set `--cinder-form-reading-column-width` to change the width.

focusProblemOnSubmit.description:
After `onSubmit` settles, moves focus to the first field that reports a problem
(`aria-invalid="true"`), so a Save that stays enabled while the form is invalid tells the
person where to look. Set `false` when the page manages focus itself.

unsupportedProps.name: children
unsupportedProps.description: Form controls. Receives `{ submitting }` so descendants can disable themselves while `onSubmit` is pending.

unsupportedProps.name: onSubmit
unsupportedProps.description: May return a promise; while pending, the child snippet receives `{ submitting: true }` and duplicate submits are ignored until it settles.
